tasks.name: Engine Decision Record
tasks.objective: Produce the Engine Decision Record for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Each candidate engine scored against the GDD's hard requirements
Decision recorded as an ADR with alternatives and rejected reasons
Licensing, team skill and platform support addressed
Migration cost stated if the decision is later reversed

tasks.name: Runtime Architecture
tasks.objective: Produce the Runtime Architecture for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Game loop, update order and frame budget documented
Scene graph or ECS model and its ownership rules described
Memory budgets per subsystem and allocation policy stated
Every module has an owning department

tasks.name: Platform and Build Matrix
tasks.objective: Produce the Platform and Build Matrix for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Every supported platform listed with target resolution and quality tier
Build and export commands recorded and runnable
Input devices and storefront constraints listed per platform
